Major transit projects can sometimes spend years in the planning stages, before funding is set and construction begins.
This section will help you keep up-to-date, as project ideas are conceived, planned, funded and built.

### Bridging Possibilities Bridging Possibilities is a study seeking to understand what and where there are barriers to access transit in neighborhoods within Greater Cleveland Regional Transit Authority’s (GCRTA) service area.
### Broadway TOD Corridor Plan A plan for equitable transit oriented development along the Broadway Avenue Corridor in anticipation of future Bus Rapid Transit.
### E. 120th St. Substation Replacement Furnish, install, test and commission a new 2 MW prefabricated Traction Power Substation.
### E. 79 St. Blue and Green Line Station Reconstruction The reconstruction of the existing station bringing it into a state of good repair and ADA compliance.
### Light Rail Track Reconstruction Program This is a multi-year $70 million program to reconstruct approximately 10 miles of the Light Rail Track constructed in 1980.
### MetroHealth Line Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) Aims to utilize the 25Connects study to transform the West 25th Street corridor.
### Railcar Replacement Program Replace 40 heavy railcars and 34 light railcars with 60 common railcars that can operate on both heavy and light rail systems.
### Tower City East Portals Tower City East Portal rehab project restores critical tracks and extends structure lifespan.
### W. 117th Street Bridge West 117th Street bridge rehab includes deck, platform, steel retrofits, and structural upgrades.

### Warrensville - Van Aken Station Reconstruction Van Aken Station to construct a new train station waiting platform, comfort station building, bus waiting areas, and site amenities such as seating, real time signage and bike racks.
